hook: Your Mac finally gets a volume slider for every app.
hookText: Every Mac app gets its own volume

beats.say: Smorza just launched. Turn a call down, keep the music up, and send each app to the speakers or headphones you choose.
It lives in your menu bar, and it installs no audio driver. It uses the audio taps Apple added in macOS 14.4.
It's free and open source, for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
